cc_extraction.pack_e_issue: 1 item (P1-E-R33) has no CorrectChoice field in its JSON object

pack_attribution.pack_e_ambiguous: 40 P1-E-R items follow Pack A Section E naming convention (P1-E-) but reside in pack_e (expected P1E-). Naming convention violation but zero QID collisions.

regex_specification_gap.description: 39 structurally complete P1-E-R* items blocked solely because QID format P1-E-R\d{2} does not match the expected Pack E regex /^P1E-[A-F]-\d{3}$/. All 39 items have: valid CorrectChoice (A-D), present Stem, present ExplanationCorrect, present ExplanationWrong A-D fields. All are Certified. These are FALSE POSITIVES caused by an overly strict regex.
regex_specification_gap.items: P1-E-R01 through P1-E-R32, P1-E-R34 through P1-E-R40
regex_specification_gap.resolution: Update Pack E regex per S204 recommendation: /^(P1E-[A-F]-\d{3})|(P1-E-R\d{2})$/.

structural_incompleteness.description: P1-E-R33 is missing CorrectChoice and Stem but has ExplanationCorrect, Choices {A,B,C,D}, and ExplanationWrong {A,B,C,D}. ExplanationCorrect describes IIA Standard 1110/1130 (internal audit independence). The item IS structurally incomplete — this is a TRUE POSITIVE for Gate -1 blocking.
structural_incompleteness.resolution: Archive (recommended per S205) or restore Missing fields from template match.

s320_prevention_status.question: Would S320 (wrong-variant remediation) be prevented by current identity infrastructure?
s320_prevention_status.s204_confirmation: YES — Gate -1 compound-key identity (PG-011 step 5) and TemplateFamily classification (step 4) are the mechanisms designed to prevent S320-class failures.
s320_prevention_status.current_operational_state: Steps 1-3 of PG-011 are operational (QID format, CC presence, pack attribution). Steps 4-5 (TemplateFamily, compound key) are deferred to PG-011 implementation. Until steps 4-5 are live, S320-class failures remain theoretically possible though QID-based targeting is now forbidden by Rules 9-10 (FM-001 through FM-008).
